oneLiner: 不是懒，是「现在的情绪」压过了「未来的自己」。
oneLinerEn: Not laziness—present feelings override the future self.
detail: 为什么：面对厌恶任务，大脑立刻想逃，短期缓解强化了拖延。怎么办：把任务拆小到「5 分钟能开始」；用「先做完再奖励」替代「先玩再忙」；接受不完美初稿。
detailEn: Why: facing a dreaded task, the brain flees for quick relief, reinforcing the habit. What helps: shrink tasks to 'start in 5 min'; reward after, not before; accept an imperfect first draft.

oneLiner: 一天做太多选择，后面就越随便或越冲动。
oneLinerEn: Too many choices in a day makes later ones careless or impulsive.
detail: 表现：晚饭点不动、购物乱买、对家人没耐心。为什么：自控是有限资源，会耗尽。怎么办：把重要决定放上午；固定琐碎选择（同款衣/食）；留出「不做决定」的时段。
detailEn: How it shows: can't pick dinner, impulse buys, short temper. Why: self-control is a limited, depletable resource. What helps: decide big things in the morning; automate small choices; schedule decision-free time.

oneLiner: 刷得越久越空：比较和算法在悄悄消耗你。
oneLinerEn: More scrolling, more hollow: comparison and algorithms drain you.
detail: 机制：别人的精选人生引发上行比较，多巴胺循环让人停不下。怎么办：关推送、设时段；用「主动创作」替代「被动刷」；睡前一小时不碰屏幕。
detailEn: Mechanism: others' highlights trigger upward comparison; dopamine loops keep you in. What helps: kill notifications, set time windows; create instead of scroll; no screens an hour before bed.

oneLiner: 亲密里的反应，常是童年依恋模式的重演。
oneLinerEn: How we react in love often replays childhood attachment.
detail: 三种模式：安全型（可依赖也可独处）、焦虑型（怕被弃、需确认）、回避型（疏离、怕被缠）。怎么办：看清自己的模式，用「直接表达需求」替代试探；对方模式不同别急于贴标签。
detailEn: Three patterns: secure (depend and be alone), anxious (fear abandonment, need reassurance), avoidant (distant, fear engulfment). What helps: name your pattern; say needs plainly instead of testing; don't rush to label the other.

oneLiner: 不是累了睡一觉就好，是长期失控与耗竭。
oneLinerEn: Not fixed by sleep—chronic depletion from loss of control.
detail: 三征兆：情绪耗竭、对工作疏离、效能感下降。为什么：资源长期小于需求、缺乏自主。怎么办：找回小块掌控感（自己排优先级）；设边界；必要时谈工作量调整。本站不提供诊断。
detailEn: Three signs: exhaustion, detachment, low efficacy. Why: demand outruns resources, little autonomy. What helps: reclaim small control (set your own priorities); set boundaries; discuss load if needed. Not a diagnosis here.

oneLiner: 夸「努力」比夸「聪明」更能扛挫折。
oneLinerEn: Praising effort beats praising smarts for resilience.
detail: 机制：夸天赋让人怕失败、回避难事；夸努力让人把困难当练习（成长型思维）。怎么办：描述具体行为（「你刚才很专注」），少贴「聪明/笨」标签。
detailEn: Mechanism: praising talent breeds fear of failure; praising effort treats hard tasks as practice (growth mindset). What helps: name the behavior ('you stayed focused'), avoid 'smart/dumb' labels.

oneLiner: 睡好觉，大脑才把白天的信息「归档」。
oneLinerEn: In sleep, the brain files away the day's information.
detail: 机制：深睡期巩固记忆、清理代谢废物；缺睡则学不牢、情绪更脆。怎么办：固定作息、睡前降蓝光；考前别熬夜——睡眠本身就在复习。
detailEn: Mechanism: deep sleep consolidates memory and clears waste; lack of it weakens learning and frays mood. What helps: regular sleep, less screen light; don't pull all-nighters—sleep is review.
